cp26:1.1: Nekkhammapāraminiddeso niṭṭhito. ADHIṬṬHĀNAPĀRAMITĀ Punāparaṃ yadā homi Kāsirājassa atrajo Mūgapakkho ti nāmena Temiyo ti vadanti maṃ. || ||
cp26:2.1: Soḷas' itthisahassānaṃ na vijjati pumo tadā ahorattānaṃ accayena nibbatto aham-ekako. || ||
cp26:3.1: Kicchā laddhaṃ piyaṃ puttaṃ abhijātaṃ jutindharaṃ setacchattaṃ dhārayitvāna sayane poseti maṃ pitā. || ||
cp26:4.1: Niddāyamāno sayanavare pabujjhitvāna' haṃ tadā addasaṃ paṇḍaraṃ chattaṃ yenāhaṃ nirayaṃ gato. || ||
cp26:5.1: Sahadiṭṭhassa me chattaṃ tāso uppajji bheravo vinicchayaṃ samāpanno: kath' āhaṃ imaṃ muñcissaṃ. || ||
cp26:6.1: Pubbasālohitā mayhaṃ devatā atthakāminī sā maṃ disvāna dukkhitaṃ tīsu ṭhānesu yojayi. || ||
cp26:7.1: Mā paṇḍiccayaṃ vibhāvaya bālamato sabbapāṇinaṃ sabbo jano ocināyatu evaṃ tava attho bhavissati. || ||
cp26:8.1: Evaṃ vuttāya' haṃ tassā idaṃ vacanam-abraviṃ karomi te taṃ vacanaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ bhaṇasi devate, atthakāmā 'si me amma hitakāmā 'si devate. || ||
cp26:9.1: Tassā' haṃ vacanaṃ sutvā sāgare va thalaṃ labhiṃ haṭṭho saṃviggamānaso tayo aṅge adhiṭṭhahiṃ. || ||
cp26:10.1: Mūgo ahosiṃ badhiro pakkho gativivajjito, ete aṅge adhiṭṭhāya vassāni soḷasaṃ vasiṃ. || ||
cp26:11.1: Tato me hatthapāde ca jivhaṃ sotañca maddiya anūnataṃ me passitvā kālakaṇṇīti nindiṃsu. || || Tato
cp26:12.1: jānapadā sabbe senāpatipurohitā sabbe ekamanā hutvā chaḍḍanaṃ anumodisuṃ. || ||
cp26:13.1: So' haṃ tesaṃ matiṃ sutvā haṭṭho saṃviggamānaso yassa 'tthāya tapo ciṇṇo so me attho samijjhatha. || ||
cp26:14.1: Nhāpetvā anulimpitvā veṭhetvā rājaveṭhanaṃ chattena abhisiñcitvā kāresuṃ purapadakkhinaṃ || ||
cp26:15.1: Sattāhaṃ dhārayitvāna uggate ravimaṇḍale rathena maṃ nīharitvā sarathī vanam-upāgami. || ||
cp26:16.1: Ek' okāse rathaṃ katvā sajj' assaṃ hatthamuñcito sārathi khaṇatī kāsuṃ nikhātuṃ paṭhaviyā mamaṃ. || ||
cp26:17.1: Adhiṭṭhitam-adhiṭṭhānaṃ tajjento vividhakāraṇā na bhindiṃ vata-m- adhiṭṭhānaṃ bodhiyā-yeva kāraṇā. || ||
cp26:18.1: Mātā pitā na me dessā attā me na ca dessiyo sabbaññutaṃ piyaṃ mayhaṃ tasmā vatam-adhiṭṭhahiṃ. || ||
cp26:19.1: Ete aṅge adhiṭṭhāya vassāni soḷasaṃ vasiṃ adhiṭṭhānena samo natthi esā me adhiṭṭhānapāramīti. || ||
